title: ACdS stale-secondary segidx live-extent bound
mode: ODA-guided parser fix with generated fast regression
scope: Bound live DataStorage segment-index reads when row zero refers to a stale secondary segidx
Keep valid stale-secondary layouts readable and reject oversized counts without cross-segment reads
Update the open-source parity implementation plan

localCodeInspection: src/drw_datastorage.cpp::readSegmentIndex previously bounded by the live segidx self-reference only when that reference was row zero; a stale row-zero reference therefore left the declared count bounded only by whole-section bytes

tests/dwg_reader_matrix_tests.cpp::testModelerAcDsDataIndexOrder already owned the generated reordered DataIndex/modeler association case and its existing CTest selector; the generated section now includes a valid unindexed trailing data segment
method.limitations: The regression is generated in memory and demonstrates parser bounds/association only. No native DWG, third-party reader, ACIS kernel, B-rep semantics, or consumer qualification was run.

formatBasis.authority: ODA section/index structure is the byte-layout reference; peer stale-index behavior was not used as an acceptance oracle
formatBasis.expectedDisposition: The live segment-index directory is bounded by its own declared segment extent; a valid stale secondary entry remains parseable, while an oversized count is capped and marked structurally unsafe for replay.

behavior: Use the live segidx segment-header size as the primary directory-read bound, independent of which directory row names the live segment.
Validate nonzero segment extents against the section and fail closed on an invalid extent.
Retain the existing self-reference fallback when older producer data leaves the header-size field unset.

Generate a valid stale-row-zero/live-row-three case with an unindexed trailing data segment, an oversized-count negative control, and an invalid-extent fail-closed control in the existing fast selector.
implementation.redControl: Before the parser change, the malformed-count assertion failed because the section-wide bound admitted rows from adjacent segments.

validation.commitBlocker: Shared worktree contains extensive user-owned changes; no files were staged.

decision.nextAction: Self-unblock to the next dependency-ready local slice; do not wait for optional peer, platform, or native semantic qualification.
